label: I q.12 a.7: No created intellect COMPREHEND_1s God
interpretation: God's infinite being makes him infinitely knowable, while even the light of glory received by a created intellect is finite. Replies 1–3 allow attainment and distinguish the perfection of the knowing from the entirety of its object.
attribution: The passage states that no created intellect can know God as perfectly as God is knowable, which is the premise.
